notes: *about* completes the idiom of going round that הָלַךְ רָכִיל writes and stays with the verb under rule 44; the bare *goeth* alone does not carry the roaming sense, so rule 44's surplus-particle sentence does not reach it.
רָכִיל is an adverbial accusative taking the supplied comparative *as* under rule 33, with its own *a* under rule 15.
